hey Aryaman, cookies to YC is a crazy transition!  curious, has Mercury crossed your radar at all as you've been building?
ey Ayomide, hardware tooling finally catching up to software feels like a big unlock - curious, how’s the build going?
hey Barton, congrats on the Wishboard launch! such an interesting concept.  curious, how’s the build going?
hey Brian, saw your breakdown on cover letters. the “which applications deserve one” framing feels way more useful than the usual career advice.  curious, how’s the build going with JobIntel?

hey Contessa, congrats on over a year co-founding CleanClaim AI!  curious, are you working with your first customers yet, or still in the build phase?
hey David, saw iQs just came out of stealth, exciting point to be at after building quietly for a while!  curious, how’s the build goin

hey Fro, “healthcare needs its SpaceX” is a pretty strong way to frame what Stack is taking on!  curious, how’s the build going so far?

Hey Jeremiah, saw you’re building Mojave Labs now after a pretty deep run across AI product and MLOps!  curious, how’s the build going?
Jesse, the turning every breakdown into a named guardrail point stuck with me.   curious, how’s the build going?

hey Joe, saw your background spans games, VR, UX, and studio-building! pretty cool mix of creative and technical work.  curious, how’s the build going?
